Seller image 2 (PMgAAeSwSeRqBWsV, 1200x1600) is an unstickered, straight-on vertical spine photograph showing CIVILIZATION AND ITS DISCONTENTS, SIGMUND FREUD, THE STANDARD EDITION, and the boxed Norton gull logo + NORTON in full. Exact printing number of the saved poster vs photographed copy is unverified. Perspective rectification (85x1506 plane, 83x1500 interior crop) yields an 18x320 q80 shelf spine and a 70x1280 q84 detail spine from ~1500 longitudinal by ~83 transverse native source pixels with no enlargement or pixel reconstruction.

entries.title: Logical Investigations, Volume 1
entries.editionEvidence: The actual seller-copy front, spine and back identify the gray-cloud International Library of Philosophy paperback, Volume 1, ISBN 9780415241892. It is Findlay’s translation, first published 1970, in the 2001 edition reprinted 2002. The spine crop is from the same physical copy as its matching front and back photos.

entries.title: Slaughterhouse-Five
entries.editionEvidence: eBay listing 257759195043 photographs a complete physical copy of the Dial Press Trade Paperback edition (ISBN 978-0-385-33384-9). Seller front photo (qB8AAeSwfh1qss8x, 1199x1599) matches the saved red/yellow skull cover design (yellow slab-serif author, left Boston Globe quote, black hand-lettered SLAUGHTERHOUSE-FIVE / A NOVEL); back photo (M8wAAeSwDQlqss8x, 1199x1599) prints A DIAL PRESS TRADE PAPERBACK, credits Lynn Buckley cover design and Kurt Vonnegut illustration/lettering, and carries barcode 978-0-385-33384-9; copyright page photo (LVsAAeSwS8Fqss8x, 1199x1599) confirms Dial Press Trade Paperbacks ISBN 978-0-385-33384-9. Spine photo (dh8AAeSwIiNqss8x, 1599x1199) captures the red skull front cover and the entire horizontal yellow spine in one frame with both blank ends and all printed elements (SLAUGHTERHOUSE-FIVE, red asterisk, KURT VONNEGUT, Dial Press lion emblem, and DIAL PRESS) 100% unobscured. Exact printing number of the saved poster vs photographed copy is unverified. Perspective rectification (1081x58 plane, 1072x55 interior crop, rotation 90) via source.mjs yields a 16x320 q80 shelf spine and a 55x1072 q84 detail spine at full native longitudinal resolution (~1072x55 native pixels) with no enlargement or pixel reconstruction.

entries.title: The Conquest of Happiness
entries.editionEvidence: Bookbot same-copy front, back18132031 and copyright18132033 photographs identify matching Routledge Classics paperback ISBN9780415378475, introduced2006 and sourcecopy reprinted2008, magenta background with four bananas, white Russell title, white subtitle band. Full author, Routledge logo, title and bottom banana design on spine are complete. The thumb overlaps only blank head margin; crop begins below it and trims that blank margin, leaving no skin pixels. Original photographic wear retained; exact printing unverified. Approximately11% of full physical spine length is trimmed, entirely in the blank head margin; blank-head spacing differs from an untrimmed face.

entries.title: Madness & Civilization
entries.editionEvidence: Original physical Bookbot photograph matches saved cream header, MICHEL FOUCAULT serif author, History of Insanity subtitle, skull held in hands and handwritten white title. Saved front visibly identifies V.914 and 394-71914-X, equivalent to ISBN9780394719146. Source physical front carries that same Vintage V.914 design; full spine confirms Vintage imprint and V.914. Bookbot cataloguing says1982 whereas separate matching Gillmore copy says1973; exact impression/year of the saved cover and source is unverified. Catalogue dates are not used as proof of identical printing. A small original front-price-label corner extends into blank right spine margin beside/above the sunburst. It does not cover title, author, logo rays, V.914 or Vintage wordmark. Label, age toning and wear remain in all output. Full printed design is present. Source1920x1920, approximately1490 longitudinal by88 transverse samples; detail may use1280 longitudinal samples without enlargement.

entries.title: Principles
entries.editionEvidence: Simon & Schuster confirms the hardcover ISBN. ISBN-specific product format metadata states “linen case w- half jacket.” Bookbot physical-copy photo 79055029 shows one complete as-sold composite spine: underlying linen reads LIFE & WORK and the visible beginning of PRINCIP; the white half-jacket overlays its remaining letters and carries red DALIO plus the Simon & Schuster imprint. This designed concealment is retained. The seller’s Gates/Robbins quote band and #1 NYT footer differ from the saved 5-million front; exact printing is unverified. No removal, stitching or letter reconstruction.

entries.title: The Outsiders: Eight Unconventional CEOs and Their Radically Rational Blueprint for Success
entries.editionEvidence: The eBay physical seller listing identifies the 2012 Harvard Business Review Press hardcover and ISBN 9781422162675. Its gallery pairs a front matching saved black/white typography, teal “The”, subtitle and author with a separate spine photo showing the complete stylized title, Thorndike and HBR Press mark. The expanded right edge preserves the full printed contours. No reconstruction.

entries.title: Phenomenology of Perception
entries.editionEvidence: AbeBooks listing 32473137415 identifies a 2013 Routledge paperback, ISBN 9780415834339. Seller image 1 shows the same charcoal front, white title, landscape painting, gold Maurice Merleau-Ponty name, and Routledge mark as the current poster. The full physical spine prints PHENOMENOLOGY and OF PERCEPTION as two lines, the Maurice Merleau-Ponty author line, and the Routledge R mark. Seller image 2 shows the back barcode for ISBN 9780415834339. The spine title and mark remain visible at source resolution; the small gold author lettering is soft. No glyphs are reconstructed.
